2026-09-29 initial research checked APH indexed chronology, AHRC former-officeholder page and 2015–2016 annual report, Coalition's signed 2019 survey response, contemporaneous IPA author biography, APEC 2004 institutional credits, member narrative and current ABC shareholding report. No outreach or source access controls bypassed.

Commissioner full-time status has direct documentary wording, unlike other senior titles. Employer dates remain February 2014–February 2016. A 17 February 2014 appointment-announcement search result is not necessarily the service commencement; secondary report says resignation effective 19 February 2016. Exact primary instruments remain follow-up leads; no invented boundary dates.

AHRC 2013–2014 PDF exceeded retrieval size, some archived IPA PDFs returned unavailable/404, and the Productivity Commission PDF was available only through indexed author text. Preserve these attempted avenues rather than repeatedly retrying them without new leads.

Governance at Alfred Health, Monash, AHPRA and Monyx is recorded separately from paid executive employment. Dynamic Sunrise ownership and Gondwana investment interests do not establish additional full-time employment. Member mentions start-up and capital-raising work but no separate verifiable employers or dates.

Consulting, nonprofit policy and media periods overlap extensively. No additive duration total is calculated; missing private hours are not zero. Full-time Commissioner evidence does not resolve the whole career or justify complete research status. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; retain blocked and advance national initial pass.

2026-10-02 follow-up: Alfred Health2013–14 primary annual report refines board cessation; contemporary ABC interview corroborates effective commissioner departure19February2016. LinkedIn public-index grouped Dynamic Sunrise2007–16 range preserved as an overlap discrepancy rather than overwriting APH split spells. Contemporary IPA column identifies APEC consultancy, not proof of university payroll.

Appointment media-release index identifies Federal Executive Council appointment17February2014; ABC17February2014 transcript introduction refers to taking up post tomorrow, whereas February2016 resignation report describes second anniversary. These may represent different milestones. Retain month-only commencement pending instrument. Seek leave records, APEC contracting entity, exact AHPRA board and electorate employer, and post2022 consulting hours. APH estimatesPDF restricted, IPA PDF inaccessible and LinkedIn open Internal Error; no access bypass. Last follow-up2026-10-02; blocked remains.

2026-10-03 follow-up: current APH material resolves the previously generic AHPRA entry to the Victorian Nursing and Midwifery Board and dates it 2011–2013. Wilson's first-person parliamentary account on 4 February 2026 recalls service from 2010 until about 2013; because the start is approximate and conflicts with APH, both are documented and the official year range retained. This is excluded governance, not additional public-service employment. Fresh commencement-instrument, APEC-payroll and consulting-hours searches did not resolve those gaps; record remains blocked.

2026-10-04 follow-up: a staff-history compilation records Wilson as Australian APEC Study Centre project manager and says he resigned in April 2006, refining the official 2006 endpoint to month precision. Exact electorate-office identity, APEC payroll/contract counterparty and hours, Human Rights Commissioner commencement instrument/leave, and private consulting hours remain unresolved. Narrow exact-name searches avoided prior oversized-result truncation; public-web avenues did not supply the decisive personnel or contracting records. Record remains blocked.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Primary MONSU history clarifies Monyx joint ownership and2003 formation, raising a documented conflict with official2002 director start. Equal ownership does not prove board control; governance remains excluded. Added publisher-confirmed2020 book authorship with contract, pay and writing dates unknown. Own biography adds one-year initial Monash painting study before switching subjects, without absolute dates. Reconciled APEC year/month precision and source enums. Search full-time statements concerned other commissioners, not IPA employment. Next: historical Monyx incorporation/board instruments, commissioner effective appointment and leave, consulting contracts/hours, named electorate employer.

Ages not converted into endpoints; hospitality descriptions provisionally grouped to avoid double counting. Employer entities, pay/hours and overlap remain gaps. Hosting society2018 biography supplied lead and corroboration. AHRC2013–14 new indexed asset path403; HTML year review gives activities without commencement day/leave. Dynamic Sunrise holdings in parliamentary interests identify current holding company, not proof of historical consultancy payroll; no entity or duration backcast. No totals calculated.
